verses.uthmani: حمٓ
verses.indopak: حٰمٓ ۚ
verses.transliteration: ﻿<u>ha</u>meem
verses.saheeh: Ha, Meem.
verses.khattab: Ḥâ-Mĩm
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Hā mīm: God knows best what He means by these [letters].
verses.romanUrdu: Haa Meem

verses.uthmani: وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
verses.indopak: وَالْكِتٰبِ الْمُبِيْنِ ۙ
verses.transliteration: waalkitabi almubeeni
verses.saheeh: By the clear Book,
verses.khattab: By the clear Book
verses.jalalayn: ﻿By the Book, the Qur'an, that clarifies, the one that manifests the path of guidance and what one needs of [the prescriptions of] the Law.
verses.romanUrdu: Kasam hai is wazeh kitaab ki

verses.uthmani: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَٰنًا عَرَبِيّٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّا جَعَلْنٰهُ قُرْاٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُوْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: inn<u>a</u> ja'aln<u>a</u>hu qur<u>a</u>nan 'arabiyyan la'allakum ta'qiloona
verses.saheeh: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand.
verses.khattab: Certainly, We have made it a Quran in Arabic so perhaps you will understand
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Lo! We have made it, We have brought the Book into existence [as], an Arabic Qur'an, in the language of the Arabs, that perhaps you, O people of Mecca, may understand, [that you may] comprehend its meanings.
verses.romanUrdu: Ke humne isey arabi zubaan ka Quran banaya hai taa-ke tumlog isey samjho

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِيٓ أُمِّ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَدَيۡنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ
verses.indopak: وَاِنَّهٗ فِىْۤ اُمِّ الْكِتٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيْمٌ ۗ
verses.transliteration: wainnahu fee ommi alkitabi ladayna la'aliyyun hakeemun
verses.saheeh: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.
verses.khattab: And indeed, it is—in the Master Record with Us—highly esteemed, rich in wisdom
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And it is indeed, fixed, in the Mother Book, the source of all the scriptures, namely, the Preserved Tablet, [which is] with Us (ladaynā substitutes [for fī ummi’l-kitābi, ‘in the Mother Book’]) [and it is] indeed exalted, above [all] the scriptures [that came] before it, wise, containing excellent wisdoms.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur dar haqeeqat yeh ummul kitaab mein sabt(transcribed) hai, hamare haan badi buland maratba aur hikmat se labrez kitaab

verses.uthmani: أَفَنَضۡرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَ صَفۡحًا أَن كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا مُّسۡرِفِينَ
verses.indopak: اَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنْكُمُ الذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا اَنْ كُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّسْرِفِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: afanadribu 'ankumu alththikra safhan an kuntum qawman musrifeena
verses.saheeh: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?
verses.khattab: Should We then turn the ˹Quranic˺ Reminder away from you ˹simply˺ because you have been a transgressing people
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Shall We turn away, [shall We] withhold, from you the Remembrance, the Qur'an, utterly, an utter withholding, so that you are then neither commanded nor forbidden, because you are a profligate, an idolatrous, folk? No!
verses.romanUrdu: Ab kya hum tumse bezaar hokar yeh dars-e-naseehat tumhare yahan bhejna chodh dein sirf isliye tum hadd se guzare huey log ho

verses.uthmani: وَكَمۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن نَّبِيّٖ فِي ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.indopak: وَكَمْ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ نَّبِىٍّ فِى الْاَوَّلِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: wakam arsalna min nabiyyin fee alawwaleena
verses.saheeh: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,
verses.khattab: ˹Imagine˺ how many prophets We sent to those ˹destroyed˺ before
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And how many a prophet did We send among the ancients!
verses.romanUrdu: Pehle guzri hui qaumon mein bhi baarha (baar baar) humne Nabi bheje hain

verses.uthmani: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِيٍّ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
verses.indopak: وَمَا يَأْتِيْهِمْ مِّنْ نَّبِىٍّ اِلَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wama yateehim min nabiyyin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona
verses.saheeh: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.
verses.khattab: But no prophet ever came to them without being mocked
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And never did a prophet come to them but that they used to deride him, in the same way that your people deride you — this [statement] is intended to comfort the Prophet (s).
verses.romanUrdu: Kabhi aisa nahin hua ke koi Nabi unke haan (yahan) aaya ho aur unhon ne uska mazak na udaya ho

verses.uthmani: فَأَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُم بَطۡشٗا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
verses.indopak: فَاَهْلَـكْنَاۤ اَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشًا وَّمَضٰى مَثَلُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: faahlakna ashadda minhum batshan wamada mathalu alawwaleena
verses.saheeh: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
verses.khattab: So We destroyed those who were far mightier than these ˹Meccans˺. The examples of ˹their˺ predecessors have ˹already˺ been related
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So We destroyed those who were mightier than them — than your people — in prowess, strength, and [already] there passed, there has been mentioned in previous verses, the example of the ancients, the description of how they were destroyed, and thus the sequel for your people will be the same.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir jo log insey badarja zyada taaqatwar thay unhein humne halak kardiya. Pichli qaumon ki misalien guzar chuki hain

verses.uthmani: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
verses.indopak: وَلَٮِٕنْ سَاَلْتَهُمْ مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ لَيَقُوْلُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ الْعَزِيْزُ الْعَلِيْمُ ۙ
verses.transliteration: walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda layaqoolunna khalaqahunna al'azeezu al'aleemu
verses.saheeh: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing."
verses.khattab: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, “The Almighty, All-Knowing did.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And if (wa-la-in: the lām is for oaths) you ask them, ‘Who created the heavens and the earth?’ they will surely say (the indicative nūn has been omitted because of the other nūn coming after it, and likewise the wāw [replaced by the damma in -lunna], because of two unvowelled consonants coming together), ‘The Mighty, the Knower created them’ — [this would have to be] their eventual response, that is to say, God [created them], Lord of Might and Knowledge. God, exalted be He, adds:
verses.romanUrdu: Agar tum in logon se pucho ke zameen aur aasmaano ko kisne paida kiya hai to yeh khud kahenge ke inhein usi zabardast ilmi hasti ne paida kiya hai

verses.uthmani: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَهۡدٗا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا سُبُلٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ
verses.indopak: الَّذِىْ جَعَلَ لَـكُمُ الْاَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَّ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيْهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُوْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: allathee ja'ala lakumu alarda mahdan waja'ala lakum feeha subulan la'allakum tahtadoona
verses.saheeh: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
verses.khattab: ˹He is the One˺ Who has laid out the earth for you, and set in it pathways for you so that you may find your way
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He Who made the earth a cradle for you, a flat resting-place, like a child’s cradle, and placed for you therein ways, routes, that perhaps you may be guided, to your destinations during your travels;
verses.romanUrdu: Wahi na jisne tumhare liye is zameen ko gehwara (cradle) banaya aur ismein tumhari khatir raaste bana diye taa-ke tum apni manzil e maqsood ki raah paa sako

verses.uthmani: وَٱلَّذِي نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءَۢ بِقَدَرٖ فَأَنشَرۡنَا بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةٗ مَّيۡتٗا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخۡرَجُونَ
verses.indopak: وَالَّذِىْ نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَاۤءِ مَاۤءً بِۢقَدَرٍ ۚ فَاَنْشَرْنَا بِهٖ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waallathee nazzala mina alssamai maan biqadarin faansharna bihi baldatan maytan kathalika tukhrajoona
verses.saheeh: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
verses.khattab: And ˹He is the One˺ Who sends down rain from the sky in perfect measure, with which We give life to a lifeless land. And so will you be brought forth ˹from the grave˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and Who sent down water from the heaven in measure, that is to say, in the measure that you require thereof and did not send it down in a deluge, and We revived with it a dead land. Thus — like this revivification — will you be brought forth, from your graves, alive;
verses.romanUrdu: Jisne ek khaas miqdar mein aasman se paani utara aur uske zariye se murda (dead) zameen ko jila uthaya. Isi tarah ek roz tum zameen se baramad kiye jaogey

verses.uthmani: وَٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡفُلۡكِ وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ مَا تَرۡكَبُونَ
verses.indopak: وَالَّذِىْ خَلَقَ الْاَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ الْفُلْكِ وَالْاَنْعَامِ مَا تَرْكَبُوْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: waallathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha waja'ala lakum mina alfulki waalan'ami ma tarkaboona
verses.saheeh: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount.
verses.khattab: And ˹He is the One˺ Who created all ˹things in˺ pairs, and made for you ships and animals to ride
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and Who created the pairs, the species, all of them, and made for you ships and cattle, such as camels, on which you ride (the referential pronoun has been omitted here for brevity; it is genitive in the case of the first, that is, fīhi [sc. tarkabūna fīhi, ‘you ride in them’] and accusative in the case of the second [sc. tarkabūnahā, ‘you ride them’]),
verses.romanUrdu: Wahi jisne yeh tamaam jodey (pairs) paida kiye, aur jisne tumhare liye kashtiyon (ships) aur jaanwaron ko sawari banaya taa-ke tum unki pusht (backs) par chadho

verses.uthmani: لِتَسۡتَوُۥاْ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَةَ رَبِّكُمۡ إِذَا ٱسۡتَوَيۡتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَتَقُولُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقۡرِنِينَ
verses.indopak: لِتَسْتَوٗا عَلٰى ظُهُوْرِهٖ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوْا نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ اِذَا اسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُوْلُوْا سُبْحٰنَ الَّذِىْ سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهٗ مُقْرِنِيْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: litastawoo 'ala thuhoorihi thumma tathkuroo ni'mata rabbikum itha istawaytum 'alayhi wataqooloo subhana allathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineena
verses.saheeh: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say. "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.
verses.khattab: so that you may sit firmly on their backs, and remember your Lord’s blessings once you are settled on them, saying, “Glory be to the One Who has subjected these for us, for we could have never done so ˹on our own˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿that you may sit, that you may find a firm position, upon their backs (He has made the [suffixed] pronoun a masculine plural and rendered zahr, ‘back’, plural because of the particle mā and its [plural] import); and then remember your Lord’s grace when you are settled on them, and say, ‘Glory be to Him Who has disposed this for us, and we [by] ourselves were no match for it, [not] capable [of it].
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jab unpar baitho (sit) to apne Rubb ka ehsan yaad karo aur kaho ke “paak hai woh jisne hamare liye in cheezon ko musakkhar(bas mein) kardiya warna hum unhein qaabu mein laane ki taaqat na rakhte thay

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاِنَّاۤ اِلٰى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wainna ila rabbina lamunqaliboona
verses.saheeh: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."
verses.khattab: And surely to our Lord we will ˹all˺ return.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And indeed it is to our Lord that we shall return’, [to Him that] we shall depart.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur ek roz humein apne Rubb ki taraf palatna hai”

verses.uthmani: وَجَعَلُواْ لَهُۥ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزۡءًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٞ مُّبِينٌ
verses.indopak: وَجَعَلُوْا لَهٗ مِنْ عِبَادِهٖ جُزْءًا ۗ اِنَّ الْاِنْسَانَ لَـكَفُوْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۗ
verses.transliteration: waja'aloo lahu min 'ibadihi juzan inna alinsana lakafoorun mubeenun
verses.saheeh: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.
verses.khattab: Still the pagans have made some of His creation out to be a part of Him. Indeed, humankind is clearly ungrateful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they assign to Him from among His own servants a part, when they say that the angels are God’s daughters — for a child is a part of its parent — even though the angels are [like them] servants of His, exalted be He. Man, [such as the one] who says the above-mentioned [words], is verily a manifest ingrate, one whose ungratefulness is manifest and clear.
verses.romanUrdu: (Yeh sab kuch jaante aur maante huey bhi) in logon ne uske bandon (servants) mein se baaz ko uska juz (part) bana daala, haqeeqat yeh hai ke Insaan khula ehsan faramosh hai

verses.uthmani: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ بَنَاتٖ وَأَصۡفَىٰكُم بِٱلۡبَنِينَ
verses.indopak: اَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنٰتٍ وَّاَصْفٰٮكُمْ بِالْبَنِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: ami ittakhatha mimma yakhluqu banatin waasfakum bialbaneena
verses.saheeh: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
verses.khattab: Has He taken ˹angels as His˺ daughters from what He created, and favoured you ˹O pagans˺ with sons
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or (am has the significance of the hamza of denial; the ‘saying’ is implied, in other words, a-taqūlūna, ‘[or] do you say that …’) He has adopted, from all that He has created, daughters, for Himself, and preferred you, privileged you, with sons? — that which is the necessary inference from what you claim and which by itself is an abomination.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya Allah ne apni makhlooq mein se apne liye betiyan intikhab (chose) ki aur tumhein beiton (sons) se nawaza

verses.uthmani: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مَثَلٗا ظَلَّ وَجۡهُهُۥ مُسۡوَدّٗا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
verses.indopak: وَاِذَا بُشِّرَ اَحَدُهُمْ بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهٗ مُسْوَدًّا وَّهُوَ كَظِيْمٌ
verses.transliteration: waitha bushshira ahaduhum bima daraba lilrrahmani mathalan thalla wajhuhu muswaddan wahuwa katheemun
verses.saheeh: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
verses.khattab: Whenever one of them is given the good news of what they attribute to the Most Compassionate, his face grows gloomy, as he suppresses his rage
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And when one of them is given the good tidings of that which he has attributed to the Compassionate One, [of that which] he has likened to Him by the ascription to Him of daughters — for a child is likened to its parent; in other words, when one of them is informed that a daughter has been born to him, his face becomes darkened, transformed into one laden with anguish, and he chokes inwardly, filled with anguish: so how can such a person then attribute daughters to Him? Exalted be He high above such [claims].
verses.romanUrdu: Aur haal yeh hai ke jis aulad ko yeh log us khuda e Rehman ki taraf mansoob karte hain uski wiladat ka musda (tidings/news/khabar) jab khud in mein se kisi ko diya jata hai to uske mooh par siyahi(darkens) chaa jaati hai aur woh gham se bhar jaata hai

verses.uthmani: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُاْ فِي ٱلۡحِلۡيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي ٱلۡخِصَامِ غَيۡرُ مُبِينٖ
verses.indopak: اَوَمَنْ يُّنَشَّؤُا فِى الْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى الْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِيْنٍ
verses.transliteration: awaman yunashshao fee alhilyati wahuwa fee alkhisami ghayru mubeenin
verses.saheeh: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah]?
verses.khattab: ˹Do they attribute to Him˺ those who are brought up in fineries and are not commanding in disputes
verses.jalalayn: ﻿What! (a-wa contains both the hamza of denial and the conjunctive waw, ‘and’, in other words, ‘do they ascribe to God …’) one that is brought up amid trinkets, ornaments, and is incoherent in a dispute?, [unable] to argue clearly because of an [inherent] inability [in this respect] as a result of [that person belonging to] the female sex.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya Allah ke hisse mein woh aulad aayi jo zewaron (ornaments) mein paali jaati hai aur behas o hujjat mein apna mudda puri tarah wazeh bhi nahin kar sakti

verses.uthmani: وَجَعَلُواْ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عِبَٰدُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ إِنَٰثًا ۚ أَشَهِدُواْ خَلۡقَهُمۡ ۚ سَتُكۡتَبُ شَهَٰدَتُهُمۡ وَيُسۡـَٔلُونَ
verses.indopak: وَجَعَلُوا الْمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةَ الَّذِيْنَ هُمْ عِبَادُ الرَّحْمٰنِ اِنَاثًا ۗ اَشَهِدُوْا خَلْقَهُمْ ۗ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَادَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔــلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waja'aloo almalaikata allatheena hum 'ibadu alrrahmani inathan ashahidoo khalqahum satuktabu shahadatuhum wayusaloona
verses.saheeh: And they have made the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
verses.khattab: Still they have labelled the angels, who are servants of the Most Compassionate, as female. Did they witness their creation? Their statement will be recorded, and they will be questioned
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they have made the angels, who are themselves servants of the Compassionate One, females. Did they witness, were they present at, their creation? Their testimony, to the effect that they are females, will be written down and they will be questioned, about it in the Hereafter, wherefore punishment will ensue for them.
verses.romanUrdu: Unhon ne farishton ko, jo khuda e Rehman ke khaas banday hain, auratein karar de liya. Kya unke jism ki saakht inhon ne dekhi hai? Inki gawahi likh li jayegi aur inhein iske jawab-dahi karni hogi

verses.uthmani: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مَا عَبَدۡنَٰهُم ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍ ۖ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَخۡرُصُونَ
verses.indopak: وَقَالُوْا لَوْ شَاۤءَ الرَّحْمٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنٰهُمْ ۗ مَا لَهُمْ بِذٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ اِنْ هُمْ اِلَّا يَخْرُصُوْنَ ۗ
verses.transliteration: waqaloo law shaa alrrahmanu ma 'abadnahum ma lahum bithalika min 'ilmin in hum illa yakhrusoona
verses.saheeh: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but falsifying.
verses.khattab: And they argue, “Had the Most Compassionate willed, we would have never worshipped them.” They have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this ˹claim˺. They do nothing but lie
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they say, ‘Had the Compassionate One [so] willed, we would not have worshipped them’, the angels: therefore our worship of them happens by His will and so He must be satisfied with it. God, exalted be He, says: They do not have any knowledge of that, which is said of His being satisfied with the worship of these [angels]; and they are only surmising, inventing lies in this [respect] and so punishment will befall them as a result thereof.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh kehte hain “agar khuda-e-Rehman chahta (ke hum unki ibadat na karein) to hum kabhi unko na poojte” yeh is maamle ki haqeeqat ko qatai nahin jaante, mehaz teer tukkay ladate hain (are simply conjecturing /guess work)

wbw.translation: we would not have worshipped them
we would not have worshipped them

verses.uthmani: أَمۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡ كِتَٰبٗا مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسۡتَمۡسِكُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمْ اٰتَيْنٰهُمْ كِتٰبًا مِّنْ قَبْلِهٖ فَهُمْ بِهٖ مُسْتَمْسِكُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: am ataynahum kitaban min qablihi fahum bihi mustamsikoona
verses.saheeh: Or have We given them a book before the Qur'an to which they are adhering?
verses.khattab: Or have We given them a Book ˹for proof˺, before this ˹Quran˺, to which they are holding firm
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or have We brought them a scripture before, that is, [before] the Qur'an, that they should worship other than God, so that they are holding fast to it? In other words, this never happened.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya humne issey pehle koi kitaab inko di thi jiski sanad [apne is malaika (farihste) parasti ke liye] yeh apne paas rakhte hon

verses.uthmani: بَلۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
verses.indopak: بَلْ قَالُـوْۤا اِنَّا وَجَدْنَاۤ اٰبَاۤءَنَا عَلٰۤى اُمَّةٍ وَّاِنَّا عَلٰۤى اٰثٰرِهِمْ مُّهْتَدُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: bal qaloo inna wajadna abaana 'ala ommatin wainna 'ala atharihim muhtadoona
verses.saheeh: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."
verses.khattab: In fact, they say, “We found our forefathers following a ˹particular˺ way, and we are following in their footsteps.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Nay, but they say, ‘Lo! we found our fathers following a [certain] creed and we are indeed, proceeding, in their footsteps to be guided’, by them, for they used to worship other than God.
verses.romanUrdu: Nahin, balke yeh kehte hain ke humne apne baap dada ko ek tarike par paya hai aur hum unhi ke nakshe qadam par chal rahe hain

verses.uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ فِي قَرۡيَةٖ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتۡرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّقۡتَدُونَ
verses.indopak: وَكَذٰلِكَ مَاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فِىْ قَرْيَةٍ مِّنْ نَّذِيْرٍ ۙ اِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوْهَاۤ ۙ اِنَّا وَجَدْنَاۤ اٰبَاۤءَنَا عَلٰۤى اُمَّةٍ وَّاِنَّا عَلٰۤى اٰثٰرِهِمْ مُّقْتَدُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wakathalika ma arsalna min qablika fee qaryatin min natheerin illa qala mutrafooha inna wajadna abaana 'ala ommatin wainna 'ala atharihim muqtadoona
verses.saheeh: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."
verses.khattab: Similarly, whenever We sent a warner to a society before you ˹O Prophet˺, its ˹spoiled˺ elite would say, “We found our forefathers following a ˹particular˺ way, and we are walking in their footsteps.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And thus We never sent a warner before you into any city without that its affluent folk, those of comfortable means, said, the like of what your people say: ‘Lo! we found our fathers following a [certain] creed and [so] we are indeed following in their footsteps’.
verses.romanUrdu: Isi tarah tumse pehle jis basti mein bhi humne koi nazeer(darane wala) bheja, uske khaate peete logon ne yahi kaha ke humne apne baap dada ko ek tareeqe par paya hai aur hum unhi ke naqshe qadam ki pairwi kar rahe hain

verses.uthmani: ۞ قَٰلَ أَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِأَهۡدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمۡ عَلَيۡهِ ءَابَآءَكُمۡ ۖ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرۡسِلۡتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
verses.indopak: ۞ قٰلَ اَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِاَهْدٰى مِمَّا وَجَدْتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ اٰبَاۤءَكُمْ ۗ قَالُوْۤا اِنَّا بِمَاۤ اُرْسِلْـتُمْ بِهٖ كٰفِرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: qala awalaw jitukum biahda mimma wajadtum 'alayhi abaakum qaloo inna bima orsiltum bihi kafiroona
verses.saheeh: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
verses.khattab: Each ˹warner˺ asked, “Even if what I brought you is better guidance than what you found your forefathers practicing?” They replied, “We totally reject whatever you have been sent with.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say, to them: ‘What! Will you follow them, even if I bring you a better [means to] guidance than what you found your fathers following?’ They say, ‘Lo! we disbelieve in what you, and those before you, are sent with’. God, exalted be He, says to them, as a threat to them:
verses.romanUrdu: Har Nabi ne unsey poocha, kya tum usi dagar par cahle jaogey khwah mein us raaste se zyada saheeh raasta tumhein bataun jispar tumne apne baap dada ko paya? Unhon ne saare Rasoolon ko yahi jawab diya ke jis deen ki taraf bulane ke liye tum bheje gaye ho hum uske kaafir hain

verses.uthmani: فَٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ ۖ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.indopak: فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: faintaqamna minhum faonthur kayfa kana 'aqibatu almukaththibeena
verses.saheeh: So we took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.
verses.khattab: So We inflicted punishment upon them. See then what was the fate of the deniers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So We took vengeance on them, that is to say, on those who denied the messengers before you; behold then how was the sequel for the deniers.
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir e kaar humne unki khabar le daali aur dekh lo ke jhutlane walon ka kya anjaam hua

verses.uthmani: وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِي بَرَآءٞ مِّمَّا تَعۡبُدُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاِذْ قَالَ اِبْرٰهِيْمُ لِاَبِيْهِ وَقَوْمِهٖۤ اِنَّنِىْ بَرَاۤءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُوْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: waith qala ibraheemu liabeehi waqawmihi innanee baraon mimma ta'budoona
verses.saheeh: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
verses.khattab: ˹Remember, O Prophet˺ when Abraham declared to his father and his people, “I am totally free of whatever ˹gods˺ you worship
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And, mention, when Abraham said to his father and his people, ‘Surely I am innocent of that which you worship,
verses.romanUrdu: Yaad karo woh waqt jab Ibrahim ne apne baap aur apni qaum se kaha tha ke “tum jinki bandagi karte ho mera unsey koi taaq nahin

verses.uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهۡدِينِ
verses.indopak: اِلَّا الَّذِىْ فَطَرَنِىْ فَاِنَّهٗ سَيَهْدِيْنِ
verses.transliteration: illa allathee fataranee fainnahu sayahdeeni
verses.saheeh: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."
verses.khattab: except the One Who originated me, and He will surely guide me.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿except Him Who originated, created, me; for He will indeed guide me’, He will show me the way to His religion.
verses.romanUrdu: Mera talluq sirf ussey hai jisne mujhe paida kiya, wahi meri rehnumayi karega”

verses.uthmani: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةَۢ بَاقِيَةٗ فِي عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
verses.indopak: وَ جَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةً فِىْ عَقِبِهٖ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waja'alaha kalimatan baqiyatan fee 'aqibihi la'allahum yarji'oona
verses.saheeh: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
verses.khattab: And he left this enduring declaration among his descendants, so they may ˹always˺ turn back ˹to Allah˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And he made it, namely, the statement of the affirmation of [God’s] Oneness, understood from his words, I shall indeed depart to my Lord; He will guide me [Q. 37:99], a word enduring among his posterity, his descendants, and thus there still remains among them those who affirm the Oneness of [God]; that perhaps they, that is, the people of Mecca, might recant, what they follow [and return] to the religion of their forefather Abraham.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur Ibrahim yahi kalima apne peechey apni aulad mein chodh gaya taa-ke woh iski taraf ruju karein

verses.uthmani: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡتُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَرَسُولٞ مُّبِينٞ
verses.indopak: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هٰۤؤُلَاۤءِ وَاٰبَاۤءَهُمْ حَتّٰى جَاۤءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ وَرَسُوْلٌ مُّبِيْنٌ
verses.transliteration: bal matta'tu haolai waabaahum hatta jaahumu alhaqqu warasoolun mubeenun
verses.saheeh: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.
verses.khattab: In fact, I had allowed enjoyment for these ˹Meccans˺ and their forefathers, until the truth came to them along with a messenger making things clear
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Nay, but I have let these, idolaters, and their fathers enjoy [life], without hastening to punish them, until there came to them the truth, the Qur'an, and a messenger who makes [things] clear, one who manifests to them the stipulations of the Law — and this [messenger] is Muhammad (s).
verses.romanUrdu: (Is ke bawajood jab yeh log dusron ki bandagi karne lagey to maine inko mita nahin diya) balke main inhein aur inke baap dada ko mata-e-hayat (sustenance) deta raha yahan tak ke inke paas haqq, aur khol khol kar bayan karne wala Rasool aa gaya

verses.uthmani: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرٞ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَمَّا جَاۤءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ قَالُوْا هٰذَا سِحْرٌ وَّاِنَّا بِهٖ كٰفِرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: walamma jaahumu alhaqqu qaloo hatha sihrun wainna bihi kafiroona
verses.saheeh: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."
verses.khattab: ˹But˺ when the truth came to them, they said, “This is magic, and we totally reject it.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But when the truth, the Qur'an, came to them, they said, ‘This is sorcery, and we are indeed disbelievers in it’.
verses.romanUrdu: Magar jab woh haqq inke paas aaya to inhon ne keh diya yeh to jaadu hai aur hum isko maanne se inkar karte hain

verses.uthmani: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَتَيۡنِ عَظِيمٍ
verses.indopak: وَقَالُوْا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنُ عَلٰى رَجُلٍ مِّنَ الْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيْمٍ
verses.transliteration: waqaloo lawla nuzzila hatha alquranu 'ala rajulin mina alqaryatayni 'atheemun
verses.saheeh: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
verses.khattab: And they exclaimed, “If only this Quran was revealed to a great man from ˹one of˺ the two cities!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they said, ‘If only this Qur'an had been revealed to some great man from, the inhabitants of, the two towns!’, in other words, from either of the two; such as al-Walīd b. al-Mughīra at Mecca or ‘Urwa b. Mas‘ūd al-Thaqafī at Tā’if.
verses.romanUrdu: Kehte hain, yeh Quran dono sheharon ke baday aadmiyon mein se kisi par kyoun na nazil kiya gaya

verses.uthmani: أَهُمۡ يَقۡسِمُونَ رَحۡمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحۡنُ قَسَمۡنَا بَيۡنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا ۚ وَرَفَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٖ دَرَجَٰتٖ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُهُم بَعۡضٗا سُخۡرِيّٗا ۗ وَرَحۡمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٞ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُونَ
verses.indopak: اَهُمْ يَقْسِمُوْنَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۗ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُمْ مَّعِيْشَتَهُمْ فِى الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجٰتٍ لِّيَـتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: ahum yaqsimoona rahmata rabbika nahnu qasamna baynahum ma'eeshatahum fee alhayati alddunya warafa'na ba'dahum fawqa ba'din darajatin liyattakhitha ba'duhum ba'dan sukhriyyan warahmatu rabbika khayrun mimma yajma'oona
verses.saheeh: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
verses.khattab: Is it they who distribute your Lord’s mercy? We ˹alone˺ have distributed their ˹very˺ livelihood among them in this worldly life and raised some of them in rank above others so that some may employ others in service. ˹But˺ your Lord’s mercy is far better than whatever ˹wealth˺ they amass
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Is it they who apportion the mercy of your Lord?, [the mercy being] prophethood. We have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world, making some of them wealthy and others poor, and raised some of them, in wealth, above others by degrees, so that some of them, who are wealthy, may take others, who are poor, in service, disposed to work for them in return for a wage (the [final] yā’ [in sukhriyyā] is attributive; a variant reading has sikhriyyan); and the mercy of your Lord, that is, Paradise, is better than what they amass, in this world.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya tere Rubb ki rehmat yeh log takseem karte hain? Duniya ki zindagi mein inki guzar basar ke zaraye to humne inke darmiyan takseem kiye hain, Aur in mein se kuch logon ko kuch dusre logon par humne badarja-ha fauqiyat di hai taa-ke yeh ek dusre se khidmat lein aur tere Rubb ki rehmat us daulat se zyada keemati hai jo (inke rahees) samait rahe hain

verses.uthmani: وَلَوۡلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ لَّجَعَلۡنَا لِمَن يَكۡفُرُ بِٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمۡ سُقُفٗا مِّن فِضَّةٖ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيۡهَا يَظۡهَرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَوْلَاۤ اَنْ يَّكُوْنَ النَّاسُ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً لَّجَـعَلْنَا لِمَنْ يَّكْفُرُ بِالرَّحْمٰنِ لِبُيُوْتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِّنْ فِضَّةٍ وَّمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُوْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: walawla an yakoona alnnasu ommatan wahidatan laja'alna liman yakfuru bialrrahmani libuyootihim suqufan min fiddatin wama'arija 'alayha yathharoona
verses.saheeh: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount
verses.khattab: Were it not that people might ˹be tempted to˺ become one community ˹of disbelievers˺, We would have supplied the homes of ˹only˺ those who disbelieve in the Most Compassionate with silver roofs and ˹silver˺ stairways to ascend
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And were it not [for the danger] that mankind would be one community, following disbelief, We would have made, for those who disbelieve in the Compassionate One, roofs (read saqfan, or plural suqufan) of silver for their houses (li-buyūtihim substitutes for li-man, ‘for those who’) and stairs, such as steps, [also] of silver, by which they ascend, [by which] they go up to the roof;
verses.romanUrdu: Agar yeh andesha na hota ke saare log ek hi tareeqe ke ho jayenge to hum khuda e Rehman se kufr karne walon ke gharon ki chatein (canopy), aur unki seedhiyan (ladders) jinse woh apne baala khaano par chadte hain

verses.uthmani: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمۡ أَبۡوَٰبٗا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيۡهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
verses.indopak: وَلِبُيُوْتِهِمْ اَبْوَابًا وَّسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِــُٔوْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: walibuyootihim abwaban wasururan 'alayha yattakioona
verses.saheeh: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
verses.khattab: as well as ˹silver˺ gates and thrones to recline on
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and doors, of silver, for their houses, and, We would have made for them, couches, of silver (surur, ‘couches’, is the plural of sarīr) on which they recline,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur unke darwaze , aur unke takhat jinpar woh takiye (pillows) laga kar baithte hain

verses.uthmani: وَزُخۡرُفٗا ۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا ۚ وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ
verses.indopak: وَزُخْرُفًا ۗ وَاِنْ كُلُّ ذٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَاعُ الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا ۗ وَالْاٰخِرَةُ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: wazukhrufan wain kullu thalika lamma mata'u alhayati alddunya waalakhiratu 'inda rabbika lilmuttaqeena
verses.saheeh: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.
verses.khattab: and ornaments ˹of gold˺. Yet all this is no more than a ˹fleeting˺ enjoyment in this worldly life. ˹But˺ the Hereafter with your Lord is ˹only˺ for those mindful ˹of Him˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and ornaments, gold: in other words, were it not for fear that a believer might disbelieve as a result of Our giving the disbeliever what has been mentioned, We would have given him such [luxuries], since the [affairs of this] world represent no danger to Us and he [the disbeliever] would then have no share in the Bliss of the Hereafter. Yet surely (wa-in: in is softened from the hardened form [inna]) all that would be nothing (read lamā, with the mā as extra; or read lammā to mean ‘but’, making the particle in for negation) but the [transient] enjoyment of the life of this world, enjoyed during it, but then perishes, and the Hereafter, Paradise, with your Lord is for the God-fearing.
verses.romanUrdu: Sab chandi aur soney (gold) ke banwa detay .Yeh to mehaz hayat e duniya ki mataah hain.Aur aakhirat tere Rubb ke haan sirf muttaqeen ke liye hai

verses.uthmani: وَمَن يَعۡشُ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضۡ لَهُۥ شَيۡطَٰنٗا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٞ
verses.indopak: وَمَنْ يَّعْشُ عَنْ ذِكْرِ الرَّحْمٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهٗ شَيْطٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهٗ قَرِيْنٌ
verses.transliteration: waman ya'shu 'an thikri alrrahmani nuqayyid lahu shaytanan fahuwa lahu qareenun
verses.saheeh: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.
verses.khattab: And whoever turns a blind eye to the Reminder of the Most Compassionate, We place at the disposal of each a devilish one as their close associate
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And whoever withdraws from, [whoever] is oblivious, to the Remembrance of the Compassionate One, namely, the Qur'an, We assign, We produce, for him a devil and he becomes his companion, never leaving his side.
verses.romanUrdu: Jo shaks Rehman ke zikar se tagaful (gaflat) barat-ta hai, hum ispar ek shaytan musallat kar detay hain aur woh uska rafiq ban jata hai

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّوْنَهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيْلِ وَيَحْسَبُوْنَ اَنَّهُمْ مُّهْتَدُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wainnahum layasuddoonahum 'ani alssabeeli wayahsaboona annahum muhtadoona
verses.saheeh: And indeed, the devils avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
verses.khattab: who will certainly hinder them from the ˹Right˺ Way while they think they are ˹rightly˺ guided
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And indeed they, that is, the devils, bar them, the blind, from the way, [from] the path of guidance, while they suppose that they are [rightly] guided (the plural [muhtadūna] takes into account the [potentially plural] sense of man, ‘whoever’, [of the previous verse]),
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh shayateen aisay logon ko raah e raast par aane se rokte hain, aur woh apni jagah yeh samajhte hain ke hum theek jaa rahe hain

verses.uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكَ بُعۡدَ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرِينُ
verses.indopak: حَتّٰۤى اِذَا جَاۤءَنَا قَالَ يٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِىْ وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرِيْنُ
verses.transliteration: hatta itha jaana qala ya layta baynee wabaynaka bu'da almashriqayni fabisa alqareenu
verses.saheeh: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "Oh, I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west - how wretched a companion."
verses.khattab: But when such a person comes to Us, one will say ˹to their associate˺, “I wish you were as distant from me as the east is from the west! What an evil associate ˹you were˺!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿until when he comes to Us, such a blind one, together with his companion, on the Day of Resurrection, he says, to him: ‘O (yā is for calling attention) would that there were between me and you the distance of the two easts!’, that is to say, like the distance between the east and the west, What an evil companion then!, you are for me. God, exalted be He, says:
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir e kaar jab yeh shaks hamare haan pahuchega to apne shaytan se kahega “kaash mere aur tere darmiyan mashriq o magrib ka boadh (doori/ distance) hota, tu to badhtareen saathi nikla”

verses.uthmani: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ إِذ ظَّلَمۡتُمۡ أَنَّكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَنْ يَّنْفَعَكُمُ الْيَوْمَ اِذْ ظَّلَمْتُمْ اَنَّكُمْ فِى الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: walan yanfa'akumu alyawma ith thalamtum annakum fee al'athabi mushtarikoona
verses.saheeh: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.
verses.khattab: ˹It will be said to both,˺ “Since you all did wrong, sharing in the punishment will be of no benefit to you this Day.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And it, your wishes or your remorse, will not benefit you, blind ones, this day, given that you did wrong, that is to say, [given that] it has become clear to you that you were wrongdoers, through your idolatry in this world, that you, together with your companions, will be sharing in the chastisement (this constitutes the justification, on the basis of an implied lām [sc. li-annakum …], for the ‘lack of benefit’; idh substitutes for al-yawma, ‘this day’).
verses.romanUrdu: Us waqt in logon se kaha jayega ke jab tum zulm kar chuke to aaj yeh baat tumhare liye kuch bhi nafeh nahin hai ke tum aur tumahre shayateen azaab mein mushtarik hain

verses.uthmani: أَفَأَنتَ تُسۡمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوۡ تَهۡدِي ٱلۡعُمۡيَ وَمَن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
verses.indopak: اَفَاَنْتَ تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ اَوْ تَهْدِى الْعُمْىَ وَمَنْ كَانَ فِىْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
verses.transliteration: afaanta tusmi'u alssumma aw tahdee al'umya waman kana fee dalalin mubeenin
verses.saheeh: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muhammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?
verses.khattab: Can you make the deaf hear, or guide the blind or those clearly astray
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Can you, then, make the deaf hear, or can you guide the blind and one who is in manifest error?, in other words, such [individuals] will not believe.
verses.romanUrdu: Ab kya aey Nabi tum behron (deaf) ko sunaoge? Ya andhon (blind) aur sareeh gumrahi mein padey huey logon ko raah dihoge

verses.uthmani: فَإِمَّا نَذۡهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنۡهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
verses.indopak: فَاِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَاِنَّا مِنْهُمْ مُّنْتَقِمُوْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: faimma nathhabanna bika fainna minhum muntaqimoona
verses.saheeh: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.
verses.khattab: Even if We take you away ˹from this world˺, We will surely inflict punishment upon them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So if (fa-immā: the conditional particle in has been assimilated herein with an extra mā) We take you away, by making you die before chastising them, then We will take vengeance on them, in the Hereafter;
verses.romanUrdu: Ab to humein inko saza deni hai khwah tumhein duniya se utha lein

verses.uthmani: أَوۡ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِي وَعَدۡنَٰهُمۡ فَإِنَّا عَلَيۡهِم مُّقۡتَدِرُونَ
verses.indopak: اَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ الَّذِىْ وَعَدْنٰهُمْ فَاِنَّا عَلَيْهِمْ مُّقْتَدِرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: aw nuriyannaka allathee wa'adnahum fainna 'alayhim muqtadiroona
verses.saheeh: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.
verses.khattab: Or if We show you what We threaten them with, We certainly have full power over them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿or We show you, during your lifetime, that which We have promised them, in the way of chastisement, for surely We have power over, [surely] We are able to chastise, them.
verses.romanUrdu: Ya tumko aankhon se inka woh anjaam dikha dein jiska humne issey waada kiya hai. Humein inpar poori qudrat haasil hai

verses.uthmani: فَٱسۡتَمۡسِكۡ بِٱلَّذِيٓ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٖ مُّسۡتَقِيمٖ
verses.indopak: فَاسْتَمْسِكْ بِالَّذِىْۤ اُوْحِىَ اِلَيْكَ ۚ اِنَّكَ عَلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ
verses.transliteration: faistamsik biallathee oohiya ilayka innaka 'ala siratin mustaqeemin
verses.saheeh: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.
verses.khattab: So hold firmly to what has been revealed to you ˹O Prophet˺. You are truly on the Straight Path
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So hold fast to that which has been revealed to you, namely, the Qur'an; surely you are on a straight path, [a straight] way.
verses.romanUrdu: Tum bahar-haal us kitaab ko mazbooti se thamay raho jo wahi ke zariye se tumhare paas bheji gayi hai, yaqeenan tum seedhey raaste par ho

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكۡرٞ لَّكَ وَلِقَوۡمِكَ ۖ وَسَوۡفَ تُسۡـَٔلُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاِنَّهٗ لَذِكْرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ ۚ وَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔـلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wainnahu lathikrun laka waliqawmika wasawfa tusaloona
verses.saheeh: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
verses.khattab: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a glory for you and your people. And you will ˹all˺ be questioned ˹about it˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And it is indeed a Reminder, an honour, for you and for your people, as it has been revealed in their language. And you will [eventually] be questioned, about [the extent of] your fulfilling your duty towards it.
verses.romanUrdu: Haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh kitaab tumahre liye aur tumhari qaum ke liye ek bahut bada sharaf hai aur anqareeb tum logon ko iski jawab-dahi karni hogi

verses.uthmani: وَسۡـَٔلۡ مَنۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلۡنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةٗ يُعۡبَدُونَ
verses.indopak: وَسْـــَٔلْ مَنْ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ مِنْ رُّسُلِنَاۤ اَجَعَلْنَا مِنْ دُوْنِ الرَّحْمٰنِ اٰلِهَةً يُّعْبَدُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waisal man arsalna min qablika min rusulina aja'alna min dooni alrrahmani alihatan yu'badoona
verses.saheeh: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?
verses.khattab: Ask ˹the followers of˺ the messengers that We already sent before you if We ˹ever˺ appointed ˹other˺ gods to be worshipped besides the Most Compassionate
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And ask those of Our messengers whom We sent before you: Did We [ever] appoint, besides the Compassionate One, that is to say, [any] other than Him, gods to be worshipped? It is said that this is to be understood literally, in other words, that God gathered for him all the messengers on the Night [of the] Journey; but it is also said that this meant [that he should ask] any communities belonging to either of the two Peoples of the Scripture. According to one of the two opinions, he never asked [anyone] since the point of this command to ask is to affirm to the idolaters of Quraysh that no messenger or scripture ever came from God with the command to worship [any] other than God.
verses.romanUrdu: Tumse pehle humne jitne Rasool bheje thay un sab se pooch dekho, kya humne khuda e Rehman ke siwa kuch dusre maabood bhi muqarrar kiye thay ke unki bandagi ki jaaye

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مُوْسٰى بِاٰيٰتِنَاۤ اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَا۟ ٮِٕهٖ فَقَالَ اِنِّىْ رَسُوْلُ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: walaqad arsalna moosa biayatina ila fir'awna wamalaihi faqala innee rasoolu rabbi al'alameena
verses.saheeh: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."
verses.khattab: Indeed, We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: “I am a messenger of the Lord of all worlds.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his council, namely, the Egyptians (al-Qibt), and he said, ‘I am indeed the messenger of the Lord of the Worlds’.
verses.romanUrdu: Humne Moosa ko apni nishaniyon ke saath Firoun aur uske ayaan-e-sultanat ke paas bheja, aur usne jaa kar kaha ke main Rubb ul aalamin ka Rasool hoon

verses.uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنۡهَا يَضۡحَكُونَ
verses.indopak: فَلَمَّا جَاۤءَهُمْ بِاٰيٰتِنَاۤ اِذَا هُمْ مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: falamma jaahum biayatina itha hum minha yadhakoona
verses.saheeh: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.
verses.khattab: But as soon as he came to them with Our signs, they laughed at them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But when he brought them Our signs, those proving his mission [from God], behold! they laughed at them.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir jab usne hamari nishaniyan unke saamne pesh ki to woh thatte (laughter) maarne lagey

verses.uthmani: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِيَ أَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ أُخۡتِهَا ۖ وَأَخَذۡنَٰهُم بِٱلۡعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
verses.indopak: وَمَا نُرِيْهِمْ مِّنْ اٰيَةٍ اِلَّا هِىَ اَكْبَرُ مِنْ اُخْتِهَا ۗ وَ اَخَذْنٰهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wama nureehim min ayatin illa hiya akbaru min okhtiha waakhathnahum bial'athabi la'allahum yarji'oona
verses.saheeh: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].
verses.khattab: although every sign We showed them was greater than the one before. Ultimately, We seized them with torments so that they might return ˹to the Right Path˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We never showed them a sign, from among the signs of chastisement, such as the flood, which was when the waters [of the Nile] penetrated their dwellings and for seven days rose as high as their throats as they sat, or [the chastisement of] the locusts, but it was greater than the one before it, the one immediately preceding it. And We seized them with chastisement, that perhaps they might recant, their disbelief.
verses.romanUrdu: Hum ek par ek aisi nishani unko dikhate chale gaye jo pehli se badh chadh kar thi, aur humne unko azaab mein dhar liya taa-ke woh apni rawish se baaz aayein

verses.uthmani: وَقَالُواْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهۡتَدُونَ
verses.indopak: وَقَالُوْا يٰۤاَيُّهَ السَّاحِرُ ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِنْدَكَ ۚ اِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waqaloo ya ayyuha alsahiru od'u lana rabbaka bima 'ahida 'indaka innana lamuhtadoona
verses.saheeh: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."
verses.khattab: ˹Then˺ they pleaded, “O ˹mighty˺ magician! Pray to your Lord on our behalf, by virtue of the covenant He made with you. We will certainly accept guidance.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they said, to Moses, upon seeing the chastisement, ‘O sorcerer! — that is to say, ‘[O] knowledgeable, perfect one’, since for them sorcery was an awesome [form of] knowledge — supplicate your Lord for us by the covenant that He has made with you, [to the effect] that He would relieve us from chastisement if we believe. Assuredly we will be guided’, that is to say, [we will become] believers.
verses.romanUrdu: Har azaab ke mauqe par woh kehte, Aey saahir (Jaadugar/magician), apne Rubb ki taraf se jo mansab tujhe haasil hai uski bina par hamare liye ussey duaa kar, hum zaroor raah-e-raast par aa jayenge

verses.uthmani: فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمۡ يَنكُثُونَ
verses.indopak: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ اِذَا هُمْ يَنْكُثُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: falamma kashafna 'anhumu al'athaba itha hum yankuthoona
verses.saheeh: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.
verses.khattab: But as soon as We removed the torments from them, they broke their promise
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But as soon as We relieved them, by the supplication of Moses, from the chastisement, behold! they had broken their pledge, reneging on their covenant and persisting in their disbelief.
verses.romanUrdu: Magar joonh hi ke hum unpar se azaab hata detay woh apni baat se phir jaatey thay

verses.uthmani: وَنَادَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِي قَوۡمِهِۦ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَلَيۡسَ لِي مُلۡكُ مِصۡرَ وَهَٰذِهِ ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِيٓ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَنَادٰى فِرْعَوْنُ فِىْ قَوْمِهٖ قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ اَلَيْسَ لِىْ مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهٰذِهِ الْاَنْهٰرُ تَجْرِىْ مِنْ تَحْتِىْ ۚ اَفَلَا تُبْصِرُوْنَ ۗ
verses.transliteration: wanada fir'awnu fee qawmihi qala ya qawmi alaysa lee mulku misra wahathihi alanharu tajree min tahtee afala tubsiroona
verses.saheeh: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?
verses.khattab: And Pharaoh called out to his people, boasting, “O my people! Am I not sovereign over Egypt as well as ˹all˺ these streams flowing at my feet? Can you not see
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And Pharaoh proclaimed, boastfully, among his people, ‘O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers, of the Nile, flowing beneath me?, that is to say, beneath my palaces. Do you not perceive?, my magnificence.
verses.romanUrdu: Ek roz Firoun ne apni qaum ke darmiyan pukar kar kaha, “logon, kya misr (egypt) ki baadshahi meri nahin hai, aur yeh nehrein (streams) mere nichey nahin beh rahi hain? Kya tum logon ko nazar nahin aata

verses.uthmani: أَمۡ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينٞ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
verses.indopak: اَمْ اَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ هٰذَا الَّذِىْ هُوَ مَهِيْنٌ ۙ وَّلَا يَكَادُ يُبِيْنُ
verses.transliteration: am ana khayrun min hatha allathee huwa maheenun wala yakadu yubeenu
verses.saheeh: Or am I [not] better than this one who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?
verses.khattab: Am I not better than this nobody who can hardly express himself
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or, do you perceive, in which case, am I not better than this one, namely, Moses, who is contemptible, feeble and lowly, and who can scarcely speak clearly?, [who can scarcely] articulate his speech, because of his lisp — which was the result of his [accidentally] placing a hot coal in his mouth when he was a child.
verses.romanUrdu: Mein behtar hoon ya yeh shaks jo zaleel o haqeer hai aur apni baat bhi khol kar bayan nahin kar sakta

verses.uthmani: فَلَوۡلَآ أُلۡقِيَ عَلَيۡهِ أَسۡوِرَةٞ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مُقۡتَرِنِينَ
verses.indopak: فَلَوْلَاۤ اُلْقِىَ عَلَيْهِ اَسْوِرَةٌ مِّنْ ذَهَبٍ اَوْ جَاۤءَ مَعَهُ الْمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: falawla olqiya 'alayhi aswiratun min thahabin aw jaa ma'ahu almalaikatu muqtarineena
verses.saheeh: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"
verses.khattab: Why then have no golden bracelets ˹of kingship˺ been granted to him or angels come with him as escorts!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Why then, if he were being truthful, have bracelets of gold (asāwira, is the plural of aswira, which is the plural of siwār, similar [in pattern] to [ghurāb] aghriba) not been cast on him — as according to their custom with those whom they made their leaders, dressing them with gold bracelets and gold necklaces — or the angels not come with him one after the other?’, in succession, to testify to his truthfulness.
verses.romanUrdu: Kyun na ispar soney (gold) ke kangan (bangles) utare gaye? Ya farishton ka ek dasta iski ardali mein na aaya?”

verses.uthmani: فَٱسۡتَخَفَّ قَوۡمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ
verses.indopak: فَاسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهٗ فَاَطَاعُوْهُ ۗ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَوْمًا فٰسِقِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: faistakhaffa qawmahu faata'oohu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena
verses.saheeh: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allah].
verses.khattab: And so he fooled his people, and they obeyed him. They were truly a rebellious people
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Thus did he, Pharaoh, persuade, incite, his people and they obeyed him, in his wish that Moses be denied. They were truly an immoral folk.
verses.romanUrdu: Usne apni qaum ko halka samjha aur unhon ne uski itaat ki, dar haqeeqat woh thay hi faasiq log

verses.uthmani: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَأَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
verses.indopak: فَلَمَّاۤ اٰسَفُوْنَا انْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَاَغْرَقْنٰهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: falamma asafoona intaqamna minhum faaghraqnahum ajma'eena
verses.saheeh: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
verses.khattab: So when they enraged Us, We inflicted punishment upon them, drowning them all
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So when they had angered Us, We took vengeance on them and drowned them all.
verses.romanUrdu: Aakhir e kaar jab unhon ne humein gazabnaak kardiya to humne unse inteqam liya aur unko ikattha garq (drown) kiya

verses.uthmani: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ سَلَفٗا وَمَثَلٗا لِّلۡأٓخِرِينَ
verses.indopak: فَجَعَلْنٰهُمْ سَلَفًا وَّمَثَلًا لِّلْاٰخِرِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: faja'alnahum salafan wamathalan lilakhireena
verses.saheeh: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.
verses.khattab: And We made them an example and a lesson for those after them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We made them a thing past (salaf, is the plural of sālif, similar [in pattern] to khādim, khadam) that is to say, a precedent, as a lesson, and an example for others, after them, that they [posterity] might take their predicament as a lesson and so not engage in actions similar to theirs.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur baad walon ke liye pesh-ro aur namoona ibrat banakar rakh diya

verses.uthmani: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوۡمُكَ مِنۡهُ يَصِدُّونَ
verses.indopak: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا اِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّوْنَ
verses.transliteration: walamma duriba ibnu maryama mathalan itha qawmuka minhu yasiddoona
verses.saheeh: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.
verses.khattab: When the son of Mary was cited as an example ˹in argument˺, your people ˹O Prophet˺ broke into ˹joyful˺ applause
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And when the son of Mary is cited as an example — after God’s [following] words were revealed: ‘Truly you and what you worship besides God shall be fuel for Hell’ [Q. 21:98] and the idolaters said, ‘We are satisfied that our gods be together with Jesus [in Hell], for he too was worshipped besides God’ — behold! your people, that is, the idolaters, laugh at it, at this example — they clamour with joy at what they hear.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jonhi ke ibne Maryam (Jesus) ki misal di gayi, tumhari qaum ke logon ne uspar gul macha diya (chilla utthey/ raised a clamour)

verses.uthmani: وَقَالُوٓاْ ءَأَٰلِهَتُنَا خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ هُوَ ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلَۢا ۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ خَصِمُونَ
verses.indopak: وَقَالُـوْۤا ءَاٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ اَمْ هُوَ ۗ مَا ضَرَبُوْهُ لَكَ اِلَّا جَدَلًا ۗ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waqaloo aalihatuna khayrun am huwa ma daraboohu laka illa jadalan bal hum qawmun khasimoona
verses.saheeh: And they said, "Are our gods better, or is he?" They did not present the comparison except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.
verses.khattab: They exclaimed, “Which is better: our gods or Jesus?” They cite him only to argue. In fact, they are a people prone to dispute
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they say, ‘Are our gods better or he?’, Jesus. We are satisfied that our gods be [in the same predicament] with him. They only cite this, that is, the example, to you for the sake of contention, [merely] arguing with falsehood, for they know that [the particle] mā [of wa-mā ta‘budūna, ‘and what you worship’] refers [only] to non-rational beings and cannot therefore include Jesus, peace be upon him. Nay, but they are a contentious lot, an extremely disputatious folk.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur lagey kehne ke hamare maabood acche hain ya woh? Yeh misaal woh tumhare saamne mehaz kach-behasi (argument/ contentiousness) ke liye laaye hain, haqeeat yeh hai ke yeh hain hi jhagdalu log

verses.uthmani: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبۡدٌ أَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ مَثَلٗا لِّبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.indopak: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا عَبْدٌ اَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنٰهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِىْۤ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ ۗ
verses.transliteration: in huwa illa 'abdun an'amna 'alayhi waja'alnahu mathalan libanee israeela
verses.saheeh: Jesus was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.
verses.khattab: He was only a servant We showed favour to, and made as an example for the Children of Israel
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He, Jesus, is only a servant [of Ours] on whom We bestowed favour, through prophethood, and We made him, by his [coming into] being without a father, an exemplar for the Children of Israel, that is to say, like an example because of the wondrousness of his case, one from which one is able to infer God’s power, exalted be He, to do whatever He will.
verses.romanUrdu: Ibne Maryam (Jesus) iske siwa kuch na tha ek banda tha jispar humne inaam kiya aur bani israel ke liye apni qudrat ka ek namuna bana diya

verses.uthmani: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلۡنَا مِنكُم مَّلَٰٓئِكَةٗ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَخۡلُفُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَوْ نَشَاۤءُ لَجَـعَلْنَا مِنْكُمْ مَّلٰۤٮِٕكَةً فِى الْاَرْضِ يَخْلُفُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: walaw nashao laja'alna minkum malaikatan fee alardi yakhlufoona
verses.saheeh: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.
verses.khattab: Had We willed, We could have easily replaced you ˹all˺ with angels, succeeding one another on earth
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And had We willed, We would have appointed among you, instead of you, angels to be [your] successors in the earth, by Our destroying you.
verses.romanUrdu: Hum chahein to tumse farishte paida kardein jo zameen mein tumhare janasheen(successors) hon

verses.uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلۡمٞ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمۡتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ
verses.indopak: وَاِنَّهٗ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُوْنِ ۗ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيْمٌ
verses.transliteration: wainnahu la'ilmun lilssa'ati fala tamtarunna biha waittabi'ooni hatha siratun mustaqeemun
verses.saheeh: And indeed, Jesus will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path.
verses.khattab: And his ˹second˺ coming is truly a sign for the Hour. So have no doubt about it, and follow me. This is the Straight Path
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And indeed he, that is, Jesus, is a portent of the Hour — [the arrival of] it is known by the sending down of him — so do not doubt it (tamtarunna: the indicative nūn has been omitted for apocopation together with the wāw of the [third] person [plural] on account of two unvowelled consonants coming together) but, say to them: ‘Follow me, in the affirmation of [God’s] Oneness. This, to which I command you, is a straight path’.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur woh dar-asal qayamat ki ek nishani hai, pas tum usmein shakk na karo meri baat maan lo, yahi seedha raasta hai

verses.uthmani: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوّٞ مُّبِينٞ
verses.indopak: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ الشَّيْطٰنُ ۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيْنٌ
verses.transliteration: wala yasuddannakumu alshshaytanu innahu lakum 'aduwwun mubeenun
verses.saheeh: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
verses.khattab: And do not let Satan hinder you, ˹for˺ he is certainly your sworn enemy
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And do not let Satan bar you, [do not let him] turn you away from God’s religion. Indeed he is a manifest enemy of yours, one whose enmity is manifest.
verses.romanUrdu: Aisa na ho shaytan tumko ussey roak de ke woh tumhara khula dushman hai

verses.uthmani: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالَ قَدۡ جِئۡتُكُم بِٱلۡحِكۡمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعۡضَ ٱلَّذِي تَخۡتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.indopak: وَ لَمَّا جَاۤءَ عِيْسٰى بِالْبَيِّنٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُمْ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَلِاُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِىْ تَخْتَلِفُوْنَ فِيْهِ ۚ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَاَطِيْعُوْنِ
verses.transliteration: walamma jaa 'eesa bialbayyinati qala qad jitukum bialhikmati waliobayyina lakum ba'da allathee takhtalifoona feehi faittaqoo allaha waatee'ooni
verses.saheeh: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me.
verses.khattab: When Jesus came with clear proofs, he declared, “I have come to you with wisdom, and to clarify to you some of what you differ about. So fear Allah, and obey me
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And when Jesus came with the clear signs, the miracles and the prescriptions [of the Law], he said, ‘Verily I have brought you wisdom, prophethood and the prescriptions of the Gospel, and [I have come] to make clear to you some of what you are at variance over, in the way of the rulings of the Torah for what concerns religion and otherwise — and he [indeed] made clear to them the matters of religion. So fear God and obey me.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jab Isa (Jesus) sareeh nishaniyan liye huey aaya tha to usne kaha tha ke “main tum logon ke paas hikmat lekar aaya hoon, aur isliye aaya hoon ke tumpar baaz un baaton ki haqeeqat khol doon jin mein tum ikhtilaf kar rahey ho, lihaza tum Allah se daro aur meri itaat karo

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٞ مُّسۡتَقِيمٞ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ رَبِّىْ وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوْهُ ۗ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيْمٌ
verses.transliteration: inna allaha huwa rabbee warabbukum fao'budoohu hatha siratun mustaqeemun
verses.saheeh: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."
verses.khattab: Surely Allah ˹alone˺ is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him ˹alone˺. This is the Straight Path.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Assuredly God is my Lord and your Lord; so worship Him — that is a straight path’.
verses.romanUrdu: Haqeeqat yeh hai ke Allah hi mera Rubb bhi hai aur tumhara Rubb bhi.Usi ki tum ibadat karo, yahi seedha raasta hai”

verses.uthmani: فَٱخۡتَلَفَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِهِمۡ ۖ فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.indopak: فَاخْتَلَفَ الْاَحْزَابُ مِنْۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ اَلِيْمٍ
verses.transliteration: faikhtalafa alahzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillatheena thalamoo min 'athabi yawmin aleemin
verses.saheeh: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.
verses.khattab: Yet their ˹various˺ groups have differed among themselves ˹about him˺, so woe to the wrongdoers when they face the torment of a painful Day
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But the factions differed among themselves, regarding [the status of] Jesus: was he God, or the son of God, or the third of Three [deities]? So woe (waylun is a term implying chastisement) to those who do wrong, [those] who blaspheme in what they say about Jesus, from the chastisement of a painful day.
verses.romanUrdu: Magar (uski is saaf taleem ke bawajood) girohon (factions) ne aapas mein ikhtilaf kiya, pas tabahi hai un logon ke liye jinhon ne zulm kiya ek dardnaak din ke azaab se

verses.uthmani: هَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
verses.indopak: هَلْ يَنْظُرُوْنَ اِلَّا السَّاعَةَ اَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَّهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: hal yanthuroona illa alssa'ata an tatiyahum baghtatan wahum la yash'uroona
verses.saheeh: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?
verses.khattab: Are they waiting for the Hour to take them by surprise when they least expect ˹it˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Are they, that is, the Meccan disbelievers, awaiting anything, that is to say — they are [in fact] awaiting nothing — but that Hour should come upon them (an ta’tiyahum substitutes for al-sā‘ata, ‘the Hour’) suddenly, unexpectedly, while they are unaware?, of the time of its coming beforehand.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya yeh log ab bas isi cheez ke muntazir hain ke achanak inpar qiyamat aa jaye aur inhein khabar bhi na ho

verses.uthmani: ٱلۡأَخِلَّآءُ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بَعۡضُهُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
verses.indopak: اَلْاَخِلَّاۤءُ يَوْمَٮِٕذٍۢ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ اِلَّا الْمُتَّقِيْنَ ۗ
verses.transliteration: alakhillao yawmaithin ba'duhum liba'din 'aduwwun illa almuttaqeena
verses.saheeh: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
verses.khattab: Close friends will be enemies to one another on that Day, except the righteous
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Friends, [who shared] in acts of disobedience in this world, will, on that day, the Day of Resurrection (yawma’idhin is semantically connected to His [following] words) be foes of one another, except for the God-fearing, those who have love for one another through their [commitment to] obedience of God — such will be friends [on that day] and it will be said to them:
verses.romanUrdu: Woh din jab aayega to muttaqin ko chodh kar baaki sab dost ek dursre ke dushman ho jayenge

verses.uthmani: يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمۡ تَحۡزَنُونَ
verses.indopak: يٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَاۤ اَنْتُمْ تَحْزَنُوْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: ya 'ibadi la khawfun 'alaykumu alyawma wala antum tahzanoona
verses.saheeh: [To whom Allah will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
verses.khattab: ˹who will be told,˺ “O My servants! There is no fear for you Today, nor will you grieve—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿‘O My servants, there is no fear for you this day, nor will you grieve,
verses.romanUrdu: Us roz un logon se jo hamari aayat par imaan laaye thay aur mutii-e-farmaan bankar rahey thay

verses.uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُواْ مُسۡلِمِينَ
verses.indopak: اَلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَكَانُوْا مُسْلِمِيْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: allatheena amanoo biayatina wakanoo muslimeena
verses.saheeh: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.
verses.khattab: ˹those˺ who believed in Our signs and ˹fully˺ submitted ˹to Us˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿those who believed (alladhīna āmanū adjectivally qualifies ‘ibādī, ‘My servants’) in Our signs — the Qur'an — and had submitted themselves [to Me].
verses.romanUrdu: Kaha jayega ke “aey mere bandon (servents), aaj tumhare liye koi khauff nahin aur na tumhein koi gham lahiq hoga

verses.uthmani: ٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ أَنتُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُكُمۡ تُحۡبَرُونَ
verses.indopak: اُدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ اَنْتُمْ وَاَزْوَاجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: odkhuloo aljannata antum waazwajukum tuhbaroona
verses.saheeh: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."
verses.khattab: Enter Paradise, you and your spouses, rejoicing.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Enter Paradise, you (antum, the subject) and your spouses, your wives, to be made joyful, to be made happy and to be honoured (tuhbarūna, ‘to be made joyful’, is the predicate of the [above] subject).
verses.romanUrdu: Dakhil ho jao jannat mein tum aur tumhari biwiyan, tumhein khush kardiya jaayega”

verses.uthmani: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِصِحَافٖ مِّن ذَهَبٖ وَأَكۡوَابٖ ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيهِ ٱلۡأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلۡأَعۡيُنُ ۖ وَأَنتُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.indopak: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِصِحَافٍ مِّنْ ذَهَبٍ وَّاَكْوَابٍ ۚ وَفِيْهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيْهِ الْاَنْفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ الْاَعْيُنُ ۚ وَاَنْتُمْ فِيْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: yutafu 'alayhim bisihafin min thahabin waakwabin wafeeha ma tashtaheehi alanfusu watalaththu ala'yunu waantum feeha khalidoona
verses.saheeh: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.
verses.khattab: Golden trays and cups will be passed around to them. There will be whatever the souls desire and the eyes delight in. And you will be there forever
verses.jalalayn: ﻿They will be served from all around with [large] dishes of gold and goblets (akwāb is the plural of kūb, which is a [drinking] vessel without a handle so that the person can drink from whichever side he wants) and therein will be whatever souls desire, to relish, and eyes delight in, contemplating, and you will abide in it [forever].
verses.romanUrdu: Unke aagay soonay (golden) ke thal (Platters) aur sagar gardish karaye jayenge aur har mann bhaati aur nigaahon ko lazzat dene wali cheez wahan maujood hogi. Unse kaha jayega, “tum ab yahan hamesha rahoge

verses.uthmani: وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِيٓ أُورِثۡتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.indopak: وَتِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِىْۤ اُوْرِثْتُمُوْهَا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: watilka aljannatu allatee oorithtumooha bima kuntum ta'maloona
verses.saheeh: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
verses.khattab: That is the Paradise which you will be awarded for what you used to do
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And that is the Paradise which you have been given to inherit [as the reward] for what you used to do.
verses.romanUrdu: Tum is jannat ke waaris apne un aamal ki wajah se huey ho jo tum duniya mein karte rahe

verses.uthmani: لَكُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٞ كَثِيرَةٞ مِّنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
verses.indopak: لَكُمْ فِيْهَا فَاكِهَةٌ كَثِيْرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: lakum feeha fakihatun katheeratun minha takuloona
verses.saheeh: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.
verses.khattab: There you will have abundant fruit to eat from
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Therein are abundant fruits for you, from which, that is, parts of which, you will eat’, for whatever is eaten is [immediately] replaced [with more of the same].
verses.romanUrdu: Tumhare liye yahan bakasrat fawake(abundant fruits) maujood hain jinhein tum khaogey”

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ فِىْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدُوْنَ ۖ
verses.transliteration: inna almujrimeena fee 'athabi jahannama khalidoona
verses.saheeh: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.
verses.khattab: Indeed, the wicked will be in the torment of Hell forever
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed the guilty will abide [forever] in the chastisement of Hell —
verses.romanUrdu: Rahe mujreem , to woh hamesha jahannum ke azaab mein mubtala rahenge

verses.uthmani: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيهِ مُبۡلِسُونَ
verses.indopak: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيْهِ مُبْلِسُوْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: la yufattaru 'anhum wahum feehi mublisoona
verses.saheeh: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.
verses.khattab: It will never be lightened for them, and there they will be overwhelmed with despair
verses.jalalayn: ﻿it will not be lightened for them and they will be [utterly] despondent in it, silent in despair.
verses.romanUrdu: Kabhi unke azaab mein kami na hogi, aur woh us mein mayous padey hongey

verses.uthmani: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنَٰهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
verses.indopak: وَمَا ظَلَمْنٰهُمْ وَ لٰـكِنْ كَانُوْا هُمُ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: wama thalamnahum walakin kanoo humu alththalimeena
verses.saheeh: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
verses.khattab: We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We never wronged them, but they themselves were the wrongdoers.
verses.romanUrdu: Unpar humne zulm nahin kiya balke woh khud hi apne upar zulm karte rahey

verses.uthmani: وَنَادَوۡاْ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقۡضِ عَلَيۡنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّٰكِثُونَ
verses.indopak: وَنَادَوْا يٰمٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۗ قَالَ اِنَّكُمْ مّٰكِثُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wanadaw ya maliku liyaqdi 'alayna rabbuka qala innakum makithoona
verses.saheeh: And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
verses.khattab: They will cry, “O Mâlik! Let your Lord finish us off.” He will answer, “You are definitely here to stay.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they will call out, ‘O Mālik — the [name of the] Keeper of the Fire — let your Lord finish us off!’, let Him make us die. He will say, after [the passing of] a thousand years, ‘You will surely remain!’, you will remain in the chastisement forever.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh pukarenge, “aey maalik, tera Rubb hamara kaam hi tamam ka de to accha hai” woh jawab dega “tum yun hi padey rahogey

verses.uthmani: لَقَدۡ جِئۡنَٰكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَكُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
verses.indopak: لَقَدْ جِئْنٰكُمْ بِالْحَـقِّ وَلٰـكِنَّ اَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كٰرِهُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: laqad jinakum bialhaqqi walakinna aktharakum lilhaqqi karihoona
verses.saheeh: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.
verses.khattab: We certainly brought the truth to you, but most of you were resentful of the truth
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God, exalted be He, says: ‘Verily We brought you, O people of Mecca, the truth, by the tongue of the Messenger, but most of you were averse to the truth’.
verses.romanUrdu: Hum tumhare paas haqq lekar aaye thay magar tum mein se aksar ko haqq hi nagawaar tha”

verses.uthmani: أَمۡ أَبۡرَمُوٓاْ أَمۡرٗا فَإِنَّا مُبۡرِمُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمْ اَبْرَمُوْۤا اَمْرًا فَاِنَّا مُبْرِمُوْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: am abramoo amran fainna mubrimoona
verses.saheeh: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan].
verses.khattab: Or have they mastered some ˹evil˺ plan? Then We ˹too˺ are surely planning
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or have they, that is, the disbelievers of Mecca, contrived, consolidated, some matter?, in plotting against the Prophet Muhammad (s). For We [too] are indeed contriving, [We too] are consolidating Our plan to destroy them.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya in logon ne koi iqdam (plot) karne ka faisla karliya hai? Accha to hum bhi phir ek faisla kiye letey hain

verses.uthmani: أَمۡ يَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسۡمَعُ سِرَّهُمۡ وَنَجۡوَىٰهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمْ يَحْسَبُوْنَ اَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوٰٮهُمْ ۗ بَلٰى وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: am yahsaboona anna la nasma'u sirrahum wanajwahum bala warusuluna ladayhim yaktuboona
verses.saheeh: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers are with them recording.
verses.khattab: Or do they think that We do not hear their ˹evil˺ thoughts and secret talks? Yes ˹We do˺! And Our messenger-angels are in their presence, recording ˹it all˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or do they reckon that We do not hear their secret thoughts and their conspiring?, that is to say, what they secretly communicate to others and what they openly conspire about among themselves. Yes indeed!, We hear [all of] that, and Our messengers, the guardians, are with them keeping a record, of that.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya inhon ne yeh samajh rakkha hai ke hum inki raaz ki baatein aur inki sargoshiyan sunte nahin hain? Hum sab kuch sun rahey hain aur hamare farishtey inke paas hi likh rahe hain

verses.uthmani: قُلۡ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ وَلَدٞ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلۡعَٰبِدِينَ
verses.indopak: قُلْ اِنْ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمٰنِ وَلَدٌ ۖ فَاَنَا۠ اَوَّلُ الْعٰبِدِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: qul in kana lilrrahmani waladun faana awwalu al'abideena
verses.saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."
verses.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “If the Most Compassionate ˹really˺ had offspring, I would be the first worshipper.”
