verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say: ‘If the Compassionate One had a son, hypothetically [speaking], I would have been first among the worshippers, of that son; but it is established that He, exalted be He, does not have a child and thus there can be no worshipping of such [a child].
verses.romanUrdu: Inse kaho, agar waqai Rehman ki koi aulad hoti to sabse pehle Ibadat karne wala main hota”

verses.uthmani: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.indopak: سُبْحٰنَ رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: subhana rabbi alssamawati waalardi rabbi al'arshi 'amma yasifoona
verses.saheeh: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
verses.khattab: Glorified is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, far above what they claim
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Glory be to the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne (the ‘arsh is the [same as the] kursī) above what they allege!’, [above] the lies which they speak in ascribing a child to Him.
verses.romanUrdu: Paak hai aasmaano aur zameen ka farma rawan, Arsh ka maalik, un saari baaton se jo yeh log us ki taraf mansoob karte hain

verses.uthmani: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
verses.indopak: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوْضُوْا وَيَلْعَبُوْا حَتّٰى يُلٰقُوْا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِىْ يُوْعَدُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: fatharhum yakhoodoo wayal'aboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yoo'adoona
verses.saheeh: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
verses.khattab: So let them indulge ˹in falsehood˺ and amuse ˹themselves˺ until they face their Day, which they have been warned of
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So leave them to indulge, their falsehoods, and play, in this world of theirs, until they encounter that day of theirs which they are promised, chastisement in, and that is the Day of Resurrection.
verses.romanUrdu: Accha, inhein apne baatil khayalat mein garq aur apne khel mein munhamik rehne do, yahan tak ke yeh apna woh din dekh lein jiska inhein khauff dilaya jaa raha hai

verses.uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَٰهٞ وَفِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَٰهٞ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
verses.indopak: وَهُوَ الَّذِىْ فِى السَّمَاۤءِ اِلٰـهٌ وَّفِى الْاَرْضِ اِلٰـهٌ ۗ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيْمُ الْعَلِيْمُ
verses.transliteration: wahuwa allathee fee alssamai ilahun wafee alardi ilahun wahuwa alhakeemu al'aleemu
verses.saheeh: And it is Allah who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.
verses.khattab: It is He Who is ˹the only˺ God in the heavens and ˹the only˺ God on the earth. For He is the All-Wise, All-Knowing
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And He it is Who in the heaven is God (fi’l-samā’i ilāhun: pronounce here both hamzas, or drop the first one or softening it into a yā’), in other words, [Who in the heaven] is the Worshipped One, and in the earth is God (both adverbials are semantically connected to what follows); and He is the Wise, in the management of His creatures, the Knower, of their welfare.
verses.romanUrdu: Wahi ek aasman mein bhi khuda hai aur zameen mein bhi khuda, aur wahi hakeem o Aleem hai

verses.uthmani: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
verses.indopak: وَتَبٰـرَكَ الَّذِىْ لَهٗ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۚ وَعِنْدَهٗ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ ۚ وَاِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: watabaraka allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma wa'indahu 'ilmu alssa'ati wailayhi turja'oona
verses.saheeh: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.
verses.khattab: And Blessed is the One to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and everything in between! With Him ˹alone˺ is the knowledge of the Hour. And to Him you will ˹all˺ be returned
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And Blessed, Magnificent, be He to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them; and with Him is the knowledge of the Hour, [of] when it shall come to pass, and to Him they will [all] be returned (yurja‘ūna, may also be read [second person plural] turja‘ūna, ‘you will be returned’).
verses.romanUrdu: Bahut baala-o-bartar hai woh jiske qabze mein zameen aur aasmaano aur har us cheez ki baadshahi hai jo zameen o aasman ke darmiyan payi jaati hai. Aur wahi qayamat ki ghadi ka ilm rakhta hai, aur usi ki taraf tum sab paltaye jaane waale ho

verses.uthmani: وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ الَّذِيْنَ يَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِهِ الشَّفَاعَةَ اِلَّا مَنْ شَهِدَ بِالْحَـقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wala yamliku allatheena yad'oona min doonihi alshshafa'ata illa man shahida bialhaqqi wahum ya'lamoona
verses.saheeh: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.
verses.khattab: ˹But˺ those ˹objects of worship˺ they invoke besides Him have no power to intercede, except those who testify to the truth knowingly
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And those whom they, the disbelievers, call on, [those whom] they worship, besides Him, that is, besides God, have no power of intercession, for anyone, except those who bear witness to the truth, that is, those who say ‘there is no god except God’, with [full] knowledge, in their hearts of what they have testified to with their tongues — such are Jesus, Ezra, and the angels, who will intercede for believers.
verses.romanUrdu: Usko chodh kar yeh log jinhein pukarte hain woh kisi shafaat ka ikhtiyar nahin rakhte, illa yeh ke koi ilm ki bina par haqq ki shahadat de

verses.uthmani: وَلَئِن سَأَلۡتَهُم مَّنۡ خَلَقَهُمۡ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤۡفَكُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَٮِٕنْ سَاَلْـتَهُمْ مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُوْلُنَّ اللّٰهُ فَاَنّٰى يُؤْفَكُوْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: walain saaltahum man khalaqahum layaqoolunna allahu faanna yufakoona
verses.saheeh: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allah." So how are they deluded?
verses.khattab: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created them, they will certainly say, “Allah!” How can they then be deluded ˹from the truth˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And if (wa-la-in: the lām is for oaths) you ask them who created them, they will surely say, ‘God’ (la-yaqūlunna: the indicative nūn and the [plural] person indicator wāw have been omitted). How can they then deviate?, [how] can they be turned away from worshipping God?
verses.romanUrdu: Aur agar tum insey pucho ke inhein kisne paida kiya hai to yeh khud kahenge ke Allah ne. Phir kahan se yeh dhoka kha rahe hain

verses.uthmani: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٞ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
verses.indopak: وَقِيْلِهٖ يٰرَبِّ اِنَّ هٰۤؤُلَاۤءِ قَوْمٌ لَّا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ ۘ
verses.transliteration: waqeelihi yarabbi inna haolai qawmun la yuminoona
verses.saheeh: And [Allah acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."
verses.khattab: ˹Allah is Aware of˺ the Prophet’s cry: “O my Lord! Indeed, these are a people who persist in disbelief.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And [as] for his saying: that is, the saying of the Prophet Muhammad (s) (wa-qīlihi is [accusative] dependent because it is a verbal noun followed by an implicit verb, in other words wa-qāla [qīlihi], ‘and he said [his saying]’) ‘O my Lord! These are indeed a people who have no faith’.
verses.romanUrdu: Kasam hai Rasool ke is qaul ki ke aey Rubb, yeh woh log hain jo maan kar nahin detay

verses.uthmani: فَٱصۡفَحۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَقُلۡ سَلَٰمٞ ۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
verses.indopak: فَاصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلٰمٌ ۗ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: faisfah 'anhum waqul salamun fasawfa ya'lamoona
verses.saheeh: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.
verses.khattab: So bear with them and respond with peace. They will soon come to know
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God, exalted be He, says: Then disregard them, leave [them] be, and say, ‘Peace!’, [I will stay away] from you — this was [revealed] before he was commanded to fight them. For they will [soon] come to know (ya‘lamūna, may also be read as [second person plural] ta‘lamūna, ‘you will [come to] know’), [meant] to threaten them.
verses.romanUrdu: Accha, aey nabi insey darguzar karo aur kehdo ke salaam hai tumhein, anqareeb inhein maaloom ho jayega
